data.description:
## Context / Problem
The infra/gerrit cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh:1-16` — Preserve sourced dependencies, evidence-line contract, throwaway branch, scenario 3’s intentional main effect. Consumer: sourced E2E driver/operators.
- `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e.sh:1-67,83-88` — Preserve live destructive scope, auth source, exit-code meanings, cleanup, environment variables, required ticket trailer. Consumer: operators/E2E scenarios.
- `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh:1-28` — Preserve stale threshold, merged/abandoned classification, read-only default, owner-confirmed deletion, auth/env inputs. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/gerrit_to_platform.ini.template:1-41` — Preserve rendering/security rule, `recheck` mapping, branch-agnostic dispatch, mirror-ref prerequisite, replication-lag mitigation. Consumer: gerrit-to-platform/materializer.
- `infra/gerrit/install-plugins.sh:1-24,87-91` — Preserve plugin pins/provenance location, verification/atomic install, environment overrides, restart requirement and OAuth boot dependency. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh:1-33` — Preserve source parameter, output files/modes, host/root requirement, no secret logging, actual parameter name. Consumer: deployment operators.
- `infra/gerrit/materialize-g2p-config.sh:1-32,78-92` — Preserve fail-closed PAT materialization, file modes, replication-config copy, atomic replacement. Consumer: deployment operators/g2p.
- `infra/gerrit/project.config:1-28,32-38,52-86,92-96,114-159,170-186,192-212` — Preserve two-vote submit requirements, DCO, label principals, contributor/feature-branch ACLs, vote-copy security conditions, disabled inherited Code-Review, Rebase-If-Necessary caveat. Consumer: Gerrit/setup script/operators.
- `infra/gerrit/register-deploy-key.sh:1-36` — Preserve idempotent write-enabled deploy-key registration, GitHub credential/scopes, public-key-only handling, why Terraform is not used if still current. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/replication.config:1-50,59-77` — Preserve one-way non-force replication, project scoping, no permissions/meta leakage, explicit refs, finite retry/persisted queue, deploy-key path, feature-ref requirement and cleanup caveat. Consumer: Gerrit replication plugin/operators.
- `infra/gerrit/reviewbot-e2e.sh:1-67,295-305` — Preserve live scope, terminal states, credential handling, cleanup, expected Gerrit/GitHub assertions. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh:1-36,64-77,90-112` — Preserve service-user creation/token rotation, secret destination, plugin token model, surgical config update. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/setup-ci-service-account.sh:1-40,83-94` — Preserve account/key scope, public-key install, private-key handling, idempotency. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/gerrit/setup-project.sh:1-22,47-90,118-122` — Preserve idempotent project/group/config convergence, feature-driver and contributor ACL intent, group UUID mapping requirement. Consumer: operators/Gerrit.
- `infra/gerrit/setup-replication.sh:1-51` — Preserve validated config install, required plugin/key prerequisites, restart/autoReload distinction, fail-closed checks. Consumer: operators/Gerrit.
- `infra/gerrit/smoke-check.sh:1-25` — Preserve dual-scope credential checks, required trailing-slash endpoint, no token logging, inputs/exits. Consumer: operators/CI.
- `infra/gerrit/webhooks.config:1-36` — Preserve internal endpoint, token-header protection, event selection and `comment-added` rerun purpose. Consumer: Gerrit webhooks plugin.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.
- [ ] No executable behavior or test assertion changes; verified by the commands under Verification exiting 0.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
